title: Micro-Mobility Modal Share of Commutes
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=ebike:ride OR sourcetype=scooter:trip)
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(purpose="commute",distance_km,0))) as micro_km by _time
| sort - _time
description: Measures how many of your commuting kilometres are on an e-bike or scooter rather than a car.
value: A rising micro-mobility share is a satisfying, measurable sign of a greener, cheaper, healthier commute.
implementation: Ingest commute trips into `index=personal`; trend micro-mobility commute distance monthly.
visualization: Column chart of monthly micro-mobility commute kilometres.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much of your commute is by e-bike or scooter instead of the car.
